$comment: Evidence provenance index. See scripts/check-evidence-integrity.mjs and docs/security/AGENTS.md. Order is a social control and is not independent acceptance.

generators.reason: prints the census to stdout and embeds the checked-out HEAD as sourceCommit; re-running it today would record a different source commit and a different tree than the artifact it is meant to reproduce
spawns real shells and writes only to an explicit --output path; a blind re-run would produce a new observation rather than reproduce the recorded one
probes the live host filesystem boundary; the recorded result is an observation of a machine state that no longer exists
requires --output and consumes a model population; re-running would run paid inference, not reproduce the recorded benchmark

artifacts.provenance: Authored by the PRE-R002/PRE-R010 triage agent from the 2026-10-28 compiler census, classifying each unresolved named reference against retained local source context; recorded by docs/audits/2026-10-28-pre-r002-r010-consumer-triage.md. No generator emits it, so the per-entry classifications are not machine-reproducible.

Captured by hand at the closeout of branch fix/d9-phase-f-remediation-v2 (source.head 7aa2e7c2, dirty:false). It is a snapshot of that branch state, not a run of a checked-in generator; the recorded status/output are claims about a tree that is described by the file itself.

Transcript of an external reproduction of google-research/harness2 at commit 1cfe254e, run in /tmp/opencode/harness2-probe with no model calls and no network. The upstream repository is not in this tree, so only the recorded transcript exists.
Output of the scripted-provider runtime-contract sweep recorded by hand at source.head d2d41adb. Scripted expectations only; no real-model capability is claimed.

Reconciliation of already-committed benchmark collections; no new model run. Each listed artifact is named by path so its own history can be checked, and this file only restates their recorded numbers.
Pilot observations on the public scope-claim-v1 fixture (holdout:false) at sourceCommit 847732c9. The fixture is a public mechanics fixture, so this is not holdout qualification.

exceptions.reason: Historic: the triage was authored and committed alongside the census it triages, in the same 2026-10-28 commit. The per-entry classifications are not machine-reproducible, so rewriting the commit would not make the relationship independently verifiable; it would only hide it.

notCovered.reason: Generated ratchet baseline for scripts/check-dox-claims.mjs, now empty; it is maintained by `pnpm check:dox --write-baseline`, not an evidence record of a tree state, and its history predates its generator so it cannot satisfy an order check without a rewrite.
